title: Expectations ledger
description: The expected status of every product x the 11 fluid stages for one profile and tier (profiles/<profile>/expected/<tier>.yaml). `lab accept` passes only if every observed status equals this ledger in BOTH directions: an unexpected `passed` fails the run just as an unexpected `failed` does. Changing a cell needs a commit that names the capability change behind it. Shape borrowed from the Gateway API conformance report (sigs.k8s.io/gateway-api, conformance/apis/v1: one report per implementation, results per profile).
$comment: Keywords are kept to the same small 2020-12 subset as site.schema.json (plus uniqueItems and not) so the stdlib L0 check can evaluate it. Stage ids are the fluid command names: `generate-artifacts` is `fluid generate artifacts`; every other id is the command itself.

profile.description: Name of the profile directory this ledger belongs to.

stagesRun.description: Whether any stage has run for this ledger. While false, nothing has run, so every cell is `pending` with the not_run code (enforced below).

runners.description: How `lab accept` drives the stages: `cli` runs fluid directly; `dag` runs the generated Airflow DAG and exists only in tiers that deploy orchestration.

products.description: Product id -> its cells, per runner.

status.description: The six status words. `waived` is reserved and not accepted.

domains.description: Domains the product runs in. Single-domain runs record cross-domain checks as `not_checked`, never `passed`.

stageMatrix.description: All 11 stages, no more and no fewer.

reasonCode.description: Stable machine tag for the reason (for example not_run, addon_absent, single_domain, slice_pending, probe_unauthorized, probe_unreachable).

capability.description: Pack capability key behind this expectation, in the <stage>.<check> form.

evidence.description: The dated run that proved this cell. Required for `passed`: a site's word never produces `passed`, only a stage's own verification does.

notRunCell.description: Nothing has run (stagesRun is false), so every cell is `pending` with the not_run code. Never `passed`.
